title: finding(test-config): the `DIST_PINS_ENABLED` guard in `vitest.config.mts` justifies itself with a premise vitest 4 no longer has — an unresolvable `--project` throws, it does not exit green
body:
Filed unassigned and ungraded by the objectui#8240 dev seat, found while checking whether a `--project` invocation could go silently green (objectui#8240 moves `apps/console`'s test scripts onto one). ⛔ Not claimed. Not fixed in that PR — it is a different file and a different claim.

## What the comment says

`vitest.config.mts` throws early when `vitest --project dist` is requested while `OBJECTUI_DIST_PINS` is not `1`, and the throw's own message states the reason:

```
'vitest --project dist was requested, but OBJECTUI_DIST_PINS is not "1", so the',
'`dist` project is NOT declared and this run would collect ZERO files and exit GREEN.',
```

## Measured, `origin/main` `0fa7a9c83`, vitest 4.1.10

An unresolvable `--project` name does **not** exit green. Vitest throws before collecting anything:

```
$ pnpm exec vitest run --project @object-ui/does-not-exist
Error: No projects matched the filter "@object-ui/does-not-exist".
exit 1
```

That is vitest's own behaviour, not something this repo adds — `if (!this.projects.length) { ... throw new Error(`No projects matched the filter "${filter}".`) }` in its project resolution. Exit code captured before any pipe.

## Why it is worth recording rather than shrugging at

⛔ **The guard itself is still worth keeping and this is not a request to delete it.** Its message is far better than vitest's generic one: it names the env var, explains that the `dist` lane needs a built package, and points at `pnpm test:dist`. That value is independent of the stale sentence.

The cost is that the sentence is load-bearing **as a fact about vitest**, and it is the fact an agent will reuse. This seat reached for it directly while deciding whether a `--project`-based package script needed its own empty-collection guard, and had to go measure it instead. Believing it leads somewhere specific and wrong: that vitest silently greens on a mistyped project name, so every `--project` call site needs a name-validity guard. It does not, and they do not — the real silent case is a project that **does** resolve and then globs zero files, which is a different mechanism with a different remedy (`--no-passWithNoTests`, as objectui#8240 uses).

Two claims are entangled in one sentence, and only one is stale:

- ⛔ stale: "an undeclared project name collects zero files and exits GREEN";
- ✅ still true: "the `dist` project is not declared unless `OBJECTUI_DIST_PINS` is `1`".

## Suggested shape of a fix

Re-word the throw's justification to say what the guard actually buys — a specific, actionable message in place of vitest's generic `No projects matched the filter` — and drop the exit-green claim. Whether the vitest-version dependency is worth pinning with a test is triage's call; a comment fix alone would close the misinformation.

Not verified: which vitest version the sentence was true of. It may well have been correct when written; nothing here suggests it was wrong at the time.

Refs: objectui#8240 (where this surfaced) · objectui#7183 (the `dist` lane).
